normalCoverPolicy: Preserve existing normal covers; show silhouettes on focus only.

genres.title: Ação
genres.prompt: Use case: text-localization. Edit target: provided genre focus cover. Change ONLY the English genre label on the left to the exact Brazilian Portuguese text "AÇÃO". Preserve the exact original black silhouettes on the right, their contours, poses, scale, layout, diagonal brush texture, black left panel and white right panel, and the original widescreen aspect ratio. No inversion of black and white. Do not redraw the characters. White uppercase bold sans-serif lettering with wide tracking, positioned and sized to fit fully inside the left black panel with safe margins, similar to the original. For FICÇÃO CIENTÍFICA use two lines if needed for legibility. Accents must be correct. All content outside the text region must remain identical. Output a single finished cover, no border, no mockup.
